lines.say: A baker cut a hole in his wall in 1937. Strangers kept asking.
caps: A baker cut *a hole* in his wall

lines.say: Vernon Rudolph only sold his doughnuts to grocery stores. But people on the sidewalk wanted them hot.
caps: People on the sidewalk *wanted them hot.*

lines.say: So he cut a hole in an outside wall and sold them right there.
caps: So he cut a hole *in the wall*

lines.say: Nobody had to be sold. Those customers were already outside, they just needed a door.
Been a minute. Chair's open Thursday.
